author: CNET
description:
Several companies are racing to become dominant forces in humanoid robots, but there's one company that seems to be excelling in multiple areas simultaneously thanks to a unique marketing strategy.

The Unitree H2X humanoid robot is pushing boundaries in a junkyard demonstration. See if this new hardware is truly a breakthrough.

Unitree is taking a distinct approach to robotics development, balancing technical capability with a bold marketing strategy. This video explores the H2X humanoid robot through a series of tests, ranging from interaction with vehicles to domestic scenarios, to see how it handles physical tasks.
